_note: Public browser settings written to browser-config.js at build time. The Maps key is a browser key restricted to the site's address and APIs in Google Cloud; googleMapsAppKey is the store apps' key (the game runs inside the app, where iPhones send no site address), limited to the three maps APIs; the PostHog project key can only send events. Leave posthogKey empty to turn analytics off. firebase is the public web config for the Rooftop Roulette Firebase project (free Spark plan); access is controlled by firebase/firestore.rules.
